title: Why bilona ghee costs more
caption:
Is your ghee really bilona? 🧈 A2 bilona ghee, explained

Real bilona ghee starts with curd, not cream. The curd is hand-churned into makkhan and slow-heated into ghee. It takes about 25–30 litres of milk to make just 1 kg, which is why it costs more.

Our A2 Bilona Cow Ghee is made from desi cow milk the traditional way.
